citation.authors: Bowen RL, Duffy SW, Ryan DA, Hart IR et al

cited_by.title: Breast cancer, triple-negative disease and screening

record.population: Black and White women with invasive breast cancer, one East London hospital, 1994-2005
record.design: Retrospective single-centre comparison of age and tumour features
record.finding: Black patients presented younger (median 46 years against 67 for White patients). Black women had more grade 3 tumours, lymph node-positive disease, hormone receptor-negative and basal-like (triple-negative) tumours. For tumours of 2 cm or less Black patients had poorer survival (hazard ratio 2.90, 95% CI 0.98-8.60, P=0.05). The authors say the findings could have major implications for detection and treatment.
record.note: One hospital; the confidence interval touches 1.
